:::{#def-saddle-point}
#### Saddle point

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$.
A [stationary point](#def-stationary-point) of $f$ that is
neither a [local minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-local-minimizer)
nor a [local maximizer](#def-local-maximizer) of $f$
is a **saddle point** of $f$
[@wikipedia_saddle_point].

:::
